svg.title: Metal fabricator — Man
svg.desc: A fictional man working as metal fabricator, wearing an apron. Visible work cue: An L-shaped metal angle section stands beside crossed tin-snips blades with two separate hand loops. The person is on the left, with the work cue on the right. Appearance: a shaved head, an oval face.
